entries.name: WVE-007
entries.stage: Recruiting Phase 1/2a monotherapy; Phase 2a combination initiation sponsor-reported
entries.summary: An investigational subcutaneous INHBE-targeting GalNAc-siRNA. The INLIGHT monotherapy registry lists recruiting Phase 1/2a research with 296 estimated participants and no posted results. Wave's 23 September 2026 announcement separately reports Phase 2a initiation with tirzepatide in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes. A post-incretin weight-maintenance trial remains planned for the second half of 2026.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for WVE-007 or the investigational combination.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development and listed UK research sites do not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock. WVE-007 is not offered for sale by SHIFT.
entries.limitations: This closes an older coverage omission, not a new October trial start. The monotherapy record was last updated on 2 June 2026 and does not describe the later tirzepatide combination; the exact-name registry search returned only that monotherapy record. Combination initiation is therefore attributed to the sponsor, not independently corroborated by a matched combination registry. December 2027 monotherapy completion remains estimated. Earlier body-composition observations are sponsor-reported; the combination synergy cited in the September announcement is preclinical, not completed human combination evidence. Imaging and lean mass do not establish strength or function, clinical benefit or tolerability superiority. Proposed once- or twice-yearly dosing is not an authorised regimen, and the maintenance trial is not treated as started.
